extracted.stage: Estate administration, IHT due before assets realisable
extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether a facility of about £779,000 could be considered to meet the inheritance tax bill on an estate valued around £7,062,500 consisting largely of commercial property and a farm.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about an inheritance tax facility for this estate. To take it further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction of the estate, details of the grant of probate status, a breakdown and valuations of the estate assets and any existing charges, the IHT payment deadline, and confirmation of the executors and your firm's involvement. We would also like to understand the expected route and timing for realising the commercial property and farm. Once we have those details a member of the team will review the information you provide. Please note this acknowledgement does not constitute an offer or any indication of terms.
